messages:
alisha: Noticing inconsistent responses when a client's request is routed to an incompatible model variant (schema mismatch / missing function tokens). Some hosts return 400, others a generic 500, a few give 422. We need a single canonical to avoid UX churn and reduce noisy retries. Thoughts?

ben: Strong vote for 422 Unprocessable Entity for payload/schema mismatches. 400 is too broad and 500 hides the root cause.

maria: +1 422. But we also need machine-actionable error codes and small headers so telemetry and the console can surface root-cause quickly.

kyle: Proposal: HTTP 422 + body error.code = MODEL_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH. Also emit header `X-Redwood-Error: signature` and `X-Redwood-Error-Schema: v1` so older clients can detect without parsing JSON.

nate: For retry semantics: these should be retryable=false by default. If runtime knows issue is transient (e.g., temporary parsing bug), set `retryable=true` and include `Retry-After`. Otherwise apps should not auto-retry.

alisha: SDKs should provide a typed exception (ModelSignatureMismatchError) with a structured details array: path, expected, received, hint. Console can show an inline fixer for obvious casts.

ben: Also add subtype for function-call mismatches: FUNCTION_ARG_MISMATCH (still 422) because remediation differs (tool wiring vs field cast).

maria: Telemetry additions: `error.type = model_signature`, `error.subtype` (signature|function_arg), `error.detail_count`, and `route.experience = pinned|flexible` so we can correlate user-impact by route type.

kyle: Console UX: new panel in the request inspector called "Signature issues" with per-field hints and a CTA to open the route's settings or a link to docs. If >5 signature errors/min mark route as "unstable" in the route list with an orange badge.

dev-platform-bot: deploy: runtime-schema-errs v12 rolled out to eu-central-1 at 2026-04-01T14:12:06Z

nate: For rollouts: when a new model is introduced, runtimes should emit a deprecation header (X-Redwood-Rollout-Note) if the new signature is incompatible and clients should be blocked until they adopt the new contract. This avoids silent production breakage.

alisha: Good. Also need migration guidance: SDK changelog + console alert when a route's target model changes signature. Product will write the microcopy: "This route's model signature changed — update your request payloads or pin the route to the prior model."

ben: Implementation tasks: runtime: standardize 422 + headers + JSON schema v1; SDK: typed exceptions + details map; telemetry: new tags + alert rules; console: request inspector panel + route-level badge and export CSV for ops.

maria: I'll add metrics (counter + histogram for detail_count) and a Grafana dash mock. Alert: fire if signature errors spike by 3x baseline or >5/min sustained.

kyle: I'll own runtime PR to emit headers and set retryable properly.

nate: I'll add rollout hooks to warn on signature changes and bubble that into the deployment UI.

alisha: Action items captured. We'll standardize on 422 + MODEL_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH / FUNCTION_ARG_MISMATCH, structured details, header shim `X-Redwood-Error` and schema version header, retryable=false by default, console inspector + route badge, telemetry + alerts, rollout warnings. Revisit in sync after PRs land. :white_check_mark:
